title: Add D&D SRD coverage and audit tests
description: Add tests and audit reports that verify D&D SRD generated-pack completeness, expected categories, stable keys, schema validity, and suspicious/missing fields.
design:
Default Vitest tests operate on the COMMITTED pack at packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/, not on live importer output. Importer is treated as a one-shot construction tool, not a per-PR generator.

DEFAULT TESTS (packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts):
- loadRulesPackFromDirectory + validateRulesPack succeed for the committed pack.
- auditPack(pack).countsByKind exactly matches a small baseline object literal (today {spell:1, creature:1}; updated by the canonical-regen PR when the pack grows). Acts as a regression guard against accidental pack drift.
- Every record.key matches /^[a-z]+:[a-z0-9-]+$/ and uses the correct kind prefix; no duplicate keys.
- Selected stable keys present (today spell:fire-bolt, creature:goblin; list grows alongside baseline).
- auditPack(pack).suspiciousRecords === [] AND missingFieldSummary === [] strict (clean today; regen PR fixes any new findings or documents a baseline before merging).
- Pack manifest license/source fields cross-check against packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json (licenseName, attributionText, sourceTitle, sourceVersion, sourceUrl). Bridges the source-pin test (srdSourceArtifact) and pack content.

MANUAL VERIFICATION COMMAND (NOT in default test suite):
- New script packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts + npm script verify:dnd5e-srd-pack.
- runImporter against the vendored PDF into a temp dir, diffPacks(committed, regenerated), formatDiffReport printed, exit non-zero on any change. Prints source SHA-256 + per-kind counts so PR notes capture them.
- Today exits 1 (committed pack is seed); after the canonical-regen PR, exits 0 unless importer/parser/source/schema/lockfile changes.

PATH-GATED CI JOB:
- New workflow .github/workflows/srd-importer-reproducibility.yml triggered on push/pull_request only when these paths change: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/**, packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/**, packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/**, packages/core/src/rules/**, package-lock.json, package.json, and the workflow file itself.
- Single job: install deps, run npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack.
- continue-on-error: true initially (committed pack is still the seed; diff is expected). The canonical-regen PR flips it to strict. Comment in the workflow points at the regen bead.

REGEN-PR PROCESS NOTE:
- Documented in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/README.md (or that file is created): the regen PR must paste verify:dnd5e-srd-pack output (no-changes + per-kind counts + source SHA-256) into the PR description and flip the gated CI job to strict.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE:
- Exact creature name-set validation: stays in loreweaver-0m9.5.14.
- Regenerating the canonical pack from the importer: future bead/PR.
- Pathfinder coverage tests: loreweaver-0m9.9.
acceptance_criteria:
- Coverage tests assert expected category counts or reviewed coverage baselines.
- Schema validation covers all generated records.
- Audit report identifies missing optional/required fields.
- Tests fail on nondeterministic output or malformed records.
close_reason: Add D&D SRD coverage and audit tests. PR #129 merged to main as commit 1f665db. Default vitest tests (srdGeneratedPack.test.ts, 14 tests) guard the committed pack on every PR; manual verify:dnd5e-srd-pack command (strict 0/1/2 exit) drives the path-gated reproducibility workflow which currently posts informational ::warning:: annotations + step summaries until loreweaver-0m9.5.20 fixes the importer/PDF section-anchor mismatch and the canonical-regen PR replaces the seed pack. Verification: npm run typecheck exit 0; npm test 1015 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failures; biome clean on touched files; all 13 PR checks green including the new SRD importer reproducibility job. Forcing close past the open-dep on 0m9.5: the 0m9.5 child importer parsers are sufficient for this bead's deliverables; the genuine open work surfaced by 0m9.6 is tracked as loreweaver-0m9.5.20.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Worktree baseline: npm install (clean), npm run typecheck (clean), npm run test (1001 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failures). Starting implementation.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Cycle 1 — srdGeneratedPack.test.ts (14 tests). RED: 2 assertions failed against the committed pack — meta.source.sourceTitle was 'D&D 5e System Reference Document 5.1' (not the verbatim SRD artifact title) and per-record license.attributionText was still the pre-bnb paraphrase. GREEN: fixed manifest.json source.sourceTitle to 'System Reference Document 5.1' (matches vendored source manifest) and updated both records' license.attributionText to the verbatim SRD 5.1 Legal Information preamble (matches the bnb fix to pack-level attribution). Also updated packLoader.test.ts which had hardcoded the old sourceTitle. Full suite: 1015 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failures.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Cycle 2 — verify-dnd5e-srd-pack CLI added at packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts with npm script verify:dnd5e-srd-pack. Smoke test: ran the script against the real vendored PDF and committed pack; exit code 2 with importer error 'start heading not found: /^Using Ability Scores$/'. This is a real importer bug (section anchors written against a fixture, never validated against the real SRD 5.1 PDF) and is now tracked as loreweaver-0m9.5.20 (child of 0m9.5). The verify script behaves correctly: importer failure surfaces a clear error and exit 2 (not 1).

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Final verification: npm run typecheck -> exit 0; npm test -> 1015 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failures (84 -> 85 test files); npx biome check on all touched files -> 4 files clean, 0 errors. Deliverables: (1) packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts — 14 default-on tests (schema validity, per-kind counts, key shape, stable keys, audit findings, source-manifest alignment). (2) packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts + npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack — manual diff against committed pack. (3) .github/workflows/srd-importer-reproducibility.yml — path-gated, continue-on-error:true (regen PR flips to strict). (4) README regen-PR checklist. (5) Bug fixes surfaced during cycle 1: manifest.json source.sourceTitle and records.json per-record license.attributionText were stale; both corrected. Followups filed: loreweaver-0m9.5.20 (importer section anchors do not match real vendored SRD PDF).
